traceability.evidence:
Key implementation and tests tied to docs/stories/002.0-DEV-ESLINT-CONFIG.story.md:
1) Flat-config presets and ESLint v9 support (REQ-CONFIG-PRESETS, REQ-FLAT-CONFIG) - src/index.ts: - TRACEABILITY_RULE_SEVERITIES maps all traceability rule IDs to severities. - createTraceabilityFlatConfig() returns a flat-config segment `{ rules: { ...TRACEABILITY_RULE_SEVERITIES } }`. - `const configs = { recommended: [createTraceabilityFlatConfig()], strict: [createTraceabilityFlatConfig()] };` exposes recommended/strict presets as ESLint v9 flat-config arrays. - Tests: tests/config/flat-config-presets-integration.test.ts: - Header explicitly references the story: - "* Tests for: docs/stories/002.0-DEV-ESLINT-CONFIG.story.md" - "* @story docs/stories/002.0-DEV-ESLINT-CONFIG.story.md" - `@req REQ-CONFIG-PRESETS`, `@req REQ-FLAT-CONFIG`, `@req REQ-PROJECT-INTEGRATION`. - Uses `FlatESLint` and `overrideConfig: [baseConfig, ...configs.recommended]` / `...configs.strict`. - Asserts both presets cause ESLint to report `traceability/require-story-annotation` on a simple function. - Test output from `npm test -- --verbose`: - PASS tests/config/flat-config-presets-integration.test.ts - ✓ [REQ-CONFIG-PRESETS] recommended preset enables traceability rules via documented usage - ✓ [REQ-CONFIG-PRESETS] strict preset also enables traceability rules via documented usage
2) Rule option schemas and config validation (REQ-RULE-OPTIONS, REQ-CONFIG-VALIDATION) - tests/config/eslint-config-validation.test.ts (annotated with this story): - `[REQ-RULE-OPTIONS]` verifies `validStoryReference.meta.schema[0].properties` contains `storyDirectories`, `allowAbsolutePaths`, `requireStoryExtension`. - `[REQ-CONFIG-VALIDATION]` checks `schema.additionalProperties === false`, so unknown options are rejected by ESLint. - tests/config/require-story-annotation-config.test.ts: - `[REQ-RULE-OPTIONS]` verifies `requireStoryAnnotation.meta.schema[0].properties` includes `scope` and `exportPriority`, and `additionalProperties === false`. - These schemas give structured, validated configuration for the rules, satisfying the requirement for configurable options with validation.
3) Customizable paths and safe handling of invalid options (REQ-CUSTOMIZABLE-PATHS, Error Handling acceptance, REQ-CONFIG-VALIDATION) - tests/rules/valid-story-reference.test.ts: - Multiple `[REQ-CONFIGURABLE-PATHS]` and `[REQ-PROJECT-BOUNDARY]` tests show: - Custom `storyDirectories`, `allowAbsolutePaths`, and `requireStoryExtension=false` are honored. - Story references outside the project root or using disallowed absolute paths are rejected. - Error-handling tests `[REQ-ERROR-HANDLING]` verify safe behavior when fs operations throw, confirming graceful failures rather than crashes. - tests/rules/valid-annotation-format.test.ts: - `[REQ-CONFIGURABLE-PATTERNS-*]` and `[REQ-CONFIGURABLE-PATTERNS-FALLBACK*]` tests confirm: - Custom `storyPathPattern` and `requirementIdPattern` can be configured. - Invalid pattern values trigger config error reporting but the rule falls back to default behavior instead of breaking ESLint. - Example text for patterns appears in error messages, matching “helpful error messages”. - Together, these show customizable story paths and robust handling of invalid configuration options at rule level, satisfying REQ-CUSTOMIZABLE-PATHS and the Error Handling acceptance criterion.
4) ESLint v9 flat config best practices and integration (REQ-FLAT-CONFIG, REQ-PROJECT-INTEGRATION, Quality Standards & Integration acceptance) - eslint.config.js: - Top-level JSDoc: `@story docs/stories/002.0-DEV-ESLINT-CONFIG.story.md`, `@req REQ-FLAT-CONFIG`. - Exports an array of flat-config objects using `@eslint/js` recommended, per-file overrides for TS, JS, tests, and ignore patterns. - Dynamically loads the plugin from `./src/index.js` or `./lib/src/index.js` and registers it under `plugins` where available. - This file is itself a working ESLint v9 flat config integrating the plugin with other rules and environments.
5) User-facing documentation and troubleshooting (User Experience & Documentation acceptance, REQ-PROJECT-INTEGRATION) - docs/config-presets.md: - Documents `recommended` and `strict` presets. - Provides canonical flat-config examples: - `export default [ js.configs.recommended, { plugins: { traceability } }, ...traceability.configs.recommended ];` - Explains that presets define only rule severities and must be spread after a `plugins` registration object. - README.md: - Quick-start flat-config example with `traceability.configs.recommended`. - Links to ESLint 9 Setup Guide, API reference, examples, and migration guide. - user-docs/eslint-9-setup-guide.md: - Detailed guidance for ESLint 9 flat config, including: - Quick setup with traceability presets. - Config patterns for JS-only, TS-only, mixed JS/TS, monorepos, Node config files, and tests. - A Troubleshooting section for common ESLint flat-config issues, including mixed JS/TS projects. - These documents provide clear setup instructions, examples, and troubleshooting for typical project types, matching user experience and documentation criteria.
6) Overall test status - `npm test -- --verbose` output shows: - Test Suites: 35 passed, 35 total - Tests: 266 passed, 266 total - All tests tied explicitly to docs/stories/002.0-DEV-ESLINT-CONFIG.story.md (the three config-related test files) pass successfully.
traceability.notes: The ESLint configuration story 002.0-DEV-ESLINT-CONFIG is fully implemented. The plugin exposes recommended and strict presets as ESLint v9 flat-config arrays that define rule severities and are intended to be spread after a `plugins` registration object. These presets are verified end-to-end with FlatESLint, proving seamless integration with existing ESLint setups. Rule schemas for key rules expose configurable options (including story directory and rule behavior options) and disallow unknown properties, providing configuration validation. Additional rule tests show graceful handling and clear error messages for invalid configuration values, satisfying the Error Handling and REQ-CONFIG-VALIDATION requirements. The repository’s own eslint.config.js demonstrates a working flat-config aligned with ESLint v9 best practices. User-facing documentation (docs/config-presets.md, README.md, and the ESLint 9 Setup Guide) provides clear setup instructions, examples, and troubleshooting for common JS, TS, mixed, and monorepo project types. All associated tests pass, so all acceptance criteria and requirements for this story are met in practice.
